description: This Go source file is the main program for a documentation internationalization (i18n) tool that processes and translates documentation files into different languages. It manages command-line arguments, file processing workflows, parallel execution, and integrates translation components.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the documentation translation tool, parsing command-line flags, preparing resources, and orchestrating processing modes (document or segment translation).

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of document files sequentially, translating each one.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes a list of document files in parallel, utilizing worker goroutines for translation.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of files sequentially for segment translation.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Resolves and returns the relative path of a file with respect to the documentation root.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters out files that do not need re-translation based on source content hashing and existing translations.
